user_intent: 期望 湿度 处于 56 % 到 68 %
如果发生火灾，那么开始报警
如果发生火灾，那么打开逃生通道
人离开时，关闭所有影音、照明、环境控制及厨电类电器
standard_taps: IF miaomiao_air_monitor.reading(pm2.5Density) >= 162 AND aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == true THEN turn_on() zhimi_air_fresh
IF xiaomi_humidity_sensor.relative_humidity() > 68 AND aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == true THEN turn_on() xiaomi_dehumidifier
IF xiaomi_humidity_sensor.relative_humidity() < 56 AND aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == true THEN turn_on() zhimi_humidifier
IF miaomiao_air_monitor.reading(RelativeHumidity) > 68 AND aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == true THEN turn_on() xiaomi_dehumidifier
IF miaomiao_air_monitor.reading(RelativeHumidity) < 56 AND aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == true THEN turn_on() zhimi_humidifier
IF aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == false THEN turn_off() xiaomi_dehumidifier
IF aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == false THEN turn_off() zhimi_air_fresh
IF aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == false THEN turn_off() zhimi_humidifier
